limits: Exact Windows Server 2022 final-package validation in ordinary and space-containing paths at 96 DPI. Native GUI launch, discovery/search reset, Downloaded view, actual compatible Use for input button and exact native input value are exercised. Explicit downloads/cancellation, socket-denied offline reuse, hashes, provenance and SAMtools scientific execution are exercised through the packaged private host. Click-through GUI download/cancel, the updater folder picker, managed-PC human usability, high-DPI/multi-monitor, Unicode/long paths, human-genome datasets and institutional proxies were not tested by this gate. No unavailable check is counted as passed.

updateMeaning: The update is from the published app-v0.6.0 starter to app 0.7.0. Each native updater transaction verified 68 target core files and preserved 187 pre-existing pack, saved-setting, reference and result files, then repeated idempotently and reopened the updated host offline. The only permitted addition was the exact one-byte user-data/session.lock coordination file.
